definitions: A specific period of time during the day when a person consumes food, often associated with intermittent fasting.
The designated hours within a 24-hour cycle during which an individual is allowed to eat, as part of a dietary regimen.
examples: My eating window is from 1 PM to 9 PM.
She shortened her eating window to six hours.
Many people find it easier to stick to a diet with a defined eating window.
